name: Ninja Star Master
body:
Although most ninja use shuriken and similar, thrown weapons sparingly, the star master effortlessly combines her martial techniques with a flurry of thrown weapons.

Thrown Weapon Specialist (Ex)

At 1st level, a star master gains Quick Draw as a bonus feat. In addition, the star master doesn’t provoke an attack of opportunity when she makes a ranged attack with a thrown weapon against an opponent that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Finally, a star master can use a shuriken as a melee weapon and she treats darts and shuriken as a dagger instead of an improvised weapon when making a melee attack with those weapon.

This ability replaces poison use.

Feinting Throw (Ex)

At 4th level, when a star master makes a ranged attack against an adjacent opponent with a thrown weapon and hits, that opponent is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC against the next melee attack that the star master makes against it before the end of her next turn. At 9th level and every 5 levels thereafter, the star master increases the number of her melee attacks that benefit from this ability by one (to a total maximum of four melee attacks).

This ability replaces dispatchment.
